title.narrative: Strengthening Water Security and Ecosystem Resilience in Pacific SIDS

description.narrative: UNESCO Pacific Office will strengthen water security and ecosystem resilience in Pacific Small Island Developing States (SIDS) by applying the Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) for 2030 framework in UNESCO-designated sites, with a pilot focus on Ant Atoll Biosphere Reserve (Federated States of Micronesia). The initiative integrates UNESCO’s Intergovernmental Hydrological Programme (IHP) and Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme with ESD approaches, transforming UNESCO-designated sites into living learning laboratories where communities, educators, and learners engage directly with water and ecosystem challenges. Through the application of the UNESCO ESD tool, the project will support experiential, site-based learning activities that link hydrological science, ecohydrology, and biodiversity conservation with climate action and sustainable resource management.
